issues.description: Late load replaces another notice and drafts disappear on navigation
issues.mechanism: Uncancelled load completion writes global notice/title/body; state has no entity or generation identity
issues.planned_check: Delay Harbor decoding, switch Ridge, verify Ridge and per-notice drafts

issues.description: Rapid saves and retries can append duplicates or lose new typing
issues.mechanism: Every invocation creates a new UUID, lacks synchronous in-flight guard and overwrites current draft after await
issues.planned_check: Burst clicks, edit while saving, switch entities; assert one operation and retained draft

issues.description: Untrusted payloads and raw error diagnostics reach UI
issues.mechanism: Payloads are type-cast and exception.message is displayed
issues.planned_check: Malformed notices and synthetic secret errors remain contained; retry available

issues.description: Preview ignores new props and fetches independently
issues.mechanism: Preview copies props to state and only reloads by id, so saved updates are stale and playground requires service
issues.planned_check: Render playground offline, replace same-id props, assert history/body updates and no API call

issues.description: Expensive timeline work repeats during typing
issues.mechanism: Spread creates new notice identity each render and preview is not memoized
issues.planned_check: Count supplied timeline observer before and after typing

issues.description: Narrow screens and long unbroken text can overflow
issues.mechanism: Grid children lack min-width:0 and wrapping; actions cannot wrap
issues.planned_check: 320px viewport plus long title/message/history, check document width and focus

issues.description: Loads overwrite other notices and drafts
issues.mechanism: The promise always sets shared notice/title/body after completion; there is no generation fence, entity cache or dirty-draft protection, and transport decoding can outlive abort.
issues.planned_check: Delay Harbor decoding, switch to Ridge, edit, and verify the late result never replaces Ridge; navigate away/back and retain drafts.

issues.description: Rapid clicks and retries append duplicate permanent revisions
issues.mechanism: Each invocation generates a new UUID, saving does not guard entry, and Retry invokes the same unguarded function.
issues.planned_check: Double-click while POST is delayed and assert one request; lose a committed response and reconcile through lookup without a second append.

issues.description: Unknown writes have no recovery fence
issues.mechanism: All errors are shown alike; a fresh save is allowed after an unknown result, so a lost response can duplicate a committed revision.
issues.planned_check: Exercise pending, absent, committed and failed lookup outcomes; replay an absent operation only with the original key/entity/payload.

issues.description: Service payloads and errors cross the boundary unchecked
issues.mechanism: Responses are cast to Notice, empty/oversized values can be submitted, and sensitive error.message is displayed.
issues.planned_check: Return malformed/mismatched payloads and sensitive ServiceError diagnostics; verify safe feedback and zero invalid submissions.

issues.description: Save completion can erase newer typing
issues.mechanism: The returned title and body replace whatever the user typed while saving.
issues.planned_check: Type during a delayed save; check saved preview reflects the submitted snapshot and the editor retains later text.

issues.description: Preview is coupled to service and ignores prop updates
issues.mechanism: It initializes display once, loads independently by id, and never synchronizes same-id prop changes.
issues.planned_check: Render and update NoticePreview through /preview.html with network denied; assert fresh supplied title/history and no API calls.

issues.description: Costly history rerenders during editor typing
issues.location: app/src/App.tsx notice spread and app/src/Preview.tsx RevisionTimeline
issues.mechanism: A new notice object is made on every App render and the supplied expensive formatter has no memo boundary.
issues.planned_check: Count supplied timeline observer calls before/after typing and expect no additional formatting.

issues.description: Real-world text can overflow narrow layouts
issues.mechanism: Grid children have implicit minimum widths and long unbroken notice/history text has no wrapping.
issues.planned_check: Check 320px viewport and long Unicode/unbroken title/message/history for horizontal overflow and visible focus/feedback.

Q04.reason: Enabled-pristine-Save assertion rejects a legitimate no-change policy; edited saves and late-error counterfactuals succeed
